label: Interval DP
subtitle: dp[i][j] — solve subproblem on range [i, j] using a split point k
signals: split array at index k to solve left + right
useWhen: Optimal answer for [i,j] depends on split at k
Smaller intervals combine into larger ones
avoidWhen: Intervals from input — check greedy first

stateTransition.code: // Iterate by length, then start, then split point k
for len 2..n: for i 0..n-len: j = i+len-1:
dp[i][j] = min over k in [i, j-1] of dp[i][k] + dp[k+1][j] + cost
